title: The ads are so intrusive it makes the app hard to use
text: Used to be good now the ads are so intrusive it makes the app hard to use. Blocks the full screen with click bait style ‘close’ options which are parts of the ad itself

title: 3.5 stars
text: Good, easy to use app. Hate the ads.

title: Another “Free” Budget App
text: This is just another app where you have to pay for features in order to create a budget.

title: Ads you can’t exit
text:
I was ready to give a five star!  Then an ad popped up. No biggie!  Right?

Wrong!  

I was not allowed to exit until this ad for a game, I will never in my life play, was finished torturing me.

I hate that.  For that reason alone I’m removing the app and no longer interested in this company’s other budget apps I sorely need.

I guess I’ll have to pay the big bucks for a quicken program or something.

I HATE FORCED ADS!

For me it really hurts a company’s ability to showcase a reasonably priced product.

No I won’t pay for a phone app until I know I like it and it works!

I was ready to buy and check out other products.

Give me a way to close out of an ad and I will be willing to pay to get rid of ads altogether.

But when I’m forced to watch. Deal breaker.

I pay extra to stream ad free.  I at least get to see what I’m streaming before I’m forced to make a decision.

title: Okay
text: I like the app since it’s free. Plus easy to read and understand where the money is going. However I dislike the ads after so many interactions you do. Or your in the middle of entering and ad pop up. Just distracting. Overall great minus the ads.
